name: Texas Instruments BQ76972 Battery Monitor
description: The `bq76972` component reads a Texas Instruments BQ76972 battery monitor ([datasheet](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/slusfc9/slusfc9.pdf), [technical reference manual](https://www.ti.com/lit/ug/sluucw9/sluucw9.pdf)) over the [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/). The default I²C address is `0x08`.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the device. Defaults to `0x08`.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: How often to poll the monitor. Defaults to `10s`.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID used by the sensor platform and actions.

config_entries.label: CRC Enabled
config_entries.description: Use the CRC-protected I²C mode. Must match the mode the chip is configured for. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Reg Disabled
config_entries.description: Turn the chip's REG0, REG1 and REG2 regulators off during setup. Leave this off when one of them powers the host or the I²C bus. Defaults to `false`.
